items.title: 用24小时 看深圳的APEC日常故事
items.summary: 如果只用一天观察深圳，APEC经贸合作的活力并不抽象。它藏在上午驶入盐田港的列车里，藏在中午降落在宝安机场的一票青蟹里，也藏在下午驶向全球的远洋巨轮中。陆海空在这里不是三条孤立的通道，而是一张持续运转的网络：内陆货物更快出海，海外商品更快入境，创客、客商和游客更顺畅往来。
items.titleEn: Watch the daily stories of APEC in Shenzhen for 24 hours
items.summaryEn: If you look at Shenzhen in one day, the dynamism of APEC's economic and trade cooperation is not abstract. It is hidden in the morning train heading to Salt Lake Harbor, in the mid-afternoon landing at Baoding Airport, and in the afternoon in the ocean liner heading to the world's oceans. Land-sea air is not an isolated network of three channels, but a continuous network: more inland goods go out to sea, more overseas goods come in, and more entrepreneurs, customers and tourists come in and out.

items.title: 明起新一轮冷空气接踵而至 我国大部将迎大风降温
items.summary: 今天（12月14日），全国大部降水仍稀少，雨雪零散分布，冷空气影响也进入尾声阶段。不过，从明天开始，新一轮实力更强的冷空气接踵而至，将率先从新疆北部展开，随后逐渐给我国大部地区带来大风降温天气，同时西南、江汉等地降水也将增多。
items.titleEn: A new round of cold air is expected to bring much of our country to the brink of cooling.
items.summaryEn: Today (December 14), most of the country's rainfall is still scarce, rain and snow are scattered, and the effects of cold air are in the final stages. However, starting tomorrow, a new wave of stronger cold air will be delivered from northern Xinjiang, which will gradually bring cooler weather to much of China, while rainfall will increase in southwest, Jianghan and other areas.
